seLinuxOptions.description: seLinuxOptions required to run as; required for MustRunAs More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

description:
The security policy for this deployment specifies that containers must run with a mandatory SELinux context. Accordingly, the SELinux strategy is set to **MustRunAs**, enforcing that the defined labels are applied to every pod.

The required SELinux options are as follows: the user label must be **system_u**, the role label **system_r**, the type label **container_t**, and the level label **s0:c123,c456**. These settings ensure that the containers adhere to the prescribed SELinux constraints.
